name: io.github.Autario/autario-mcp
description: Connect your ads, shop, analytics, social, CRM and finance tools, and let AI explain the numbers.

environmentVariables.description: Autario API key from autario.com account settings. Optional: public datasets and stats work without it; needed for your own data, connectors and publishing.
environmentVariables.name: AUTARIO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Autario API secret paired with AUTARIO_API_KEY. Optional, same scope as the key.
environmentVariables.name: AUTARIO_API_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Optional. The autario MCP endpoint this stdio bridge connects to. Default https://autario.com/mcp; set it only for your own autario server.
environmentVariables.name: AUTARIO_MCP_URL
